name:
/bin/sh -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: count_text.py
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def count_lines(content: str) -> int:
+    return 1 + content.count(\"\\n\") if content else 0
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    input_path = Path.cwd() / \"input.txt\"
+    output_path = Path.cwd() / \"output.txt\"
+
+    try:
+        content = input_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
+    except OSError as error:
+        raise SystemExit(f\"Unable to read {input_path}: {error}\") from error
+
+    summary = (
+        f\"Lines: {count_lines(content)}\\n\"
+        f\"Words: {len(content.split())}\\n\"
+        f\"Characters: {len(content)}\\n\"
+    )
+
+    try:
+        output_path.write_text(summary, encoding=\"utf-8\")
+    except OSError as error:
+        raise SystemExit(f\"Unable to write {output_path}: {error}\") from error
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    main()
*** End Patch
PATCH
python3 count_text.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- output.txt ---'
cat output.txt"
